metaTitle: Custom Dolman Nursing Scrubs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom dolman nursing scrubs with your logo. Perfect for healthcare teams. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Dolman sleeve scrubs offer a modern, relaxed fit that gives nurses greater range of motion during long shifts. The extended armhole design reduces binding at the shoulders, making these scrubs ideal for professionals who need to move freely while still looking polished. Customize with your facility logo using embroidery or screen printing for a cohesive team look.
